data.narrative:
Axelspace is a Series D-stage space technology company founded by Yuya Nakamura. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies in Space & Aerospace, alongside observation of five public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) that establish sector context.

The peer-median method is the primary applicable triangulation approach. The four private comparables—Sierra Space ($8.0B, Series C), Apex Space ($2.3B, Series D), Varda Space Industries ($1.6B, Series D), and Skyryse ($1.1B, Series C)—yield a median valuation of $1.9B and a range spanning $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples (sector median 25.3x across six tickers) cannot be applied because Axelspace's revenue is not disclosed. The public market data serves primarily to calibrate sector multiples and volatility expectations.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.6B to $2.2B, centered at $1.9B. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single quantifiable method. Key uncertainties include Axelspace's current revenue scale and trajectory, capital efficiency relative to peers, and near-term funding requirements. The wide spread among peers ($1.1B to $8.0B) also indicates heterogeneity in the private space sector that peer-median weighting alone cannot fully resolve. Additional transparency on Axelspace's revenue and unit economics would refine this estimate.
